description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open-source testing management tool. It manages test results display, report generation (including HTML and XLS formats), and email dispatch of spreadsheets. It primarily handles the rendering of test case execution results on a test plan and platform, integrating external dependencies, initializing parameters, and building reports.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: Class for rendering external JavaScript rich tables for displaying test results matrices.

classes.name: tlHTMLTable
classes.description: Class for rendering HTML tables for test results, used as an alternative to tlExtTable in non-HTML formats.

classes.name: tlTestPlanMetrics
classes.description: Class for managing metrics related to test plans, including retrieving platforms, builds, and execution statuses.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class representing a test project, providing methods to retrieve project-specific information.

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: Class representing input parameters for processing requests.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Class for managing hierarchical test suite paths.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes request parameters with security checks and validation.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI object with test plan and project info, visualization labels, and configuration.

methods.name: buildDataSet
methods.description: Builds the dataset for display, either in HTML or XLS format, including test case execution results.

methods.name: buildMatrix
methods.description: Constructs the test results matrix table object for presentation.

methods.name: createSpreadsheet
methods.description: Creates an XLS spreadsheet containing test results, and optionally emails it or prompts download.

methods.name: doProcess
methods.description: Main processing function that retrieves data and dispatches report generation or display based on format.
